line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

decision: R1270/1271 retain typed bounded I/O and numeric far targets. R1274-1276 read targets in original order and copy the encoded byte count; aliasing and CP932 require both. R1277 restore original AX/CF success statements; retain bounded copy and immediate ERROR_INVALID_ADDRESS failure return. R1278/1279 keep wide length and bounded OEM conversion for NetAPI Unicode. No helper added and no inherited error or success code changed.
